stories.title: Mobilisation dans la Fonction Publique : 206 000 manifestants selon le ministère de l'Intérieur, 300 000 pour la CGT.

en.title: Mobilisation in Public Service: 206,000 protesters according to Interior Ministry, 300,000 for CGT
en.summary: Public sector workers staged strikes to protest against the freezing of salary index points. Nearly 10% of civil service employees participated in the strike action.

stories.title: La dette de la France atteint 119% du PIB, la fonction publique dans la rue pour le pouvoir d'achat

en.title: France's debt reaches 119% of GDP, civil service protests for purchasing power
en.summary: France's debt reached 3,595.5 billion euros in the second quarter of 2026, representing 119% of GDP, the highest level since 1946. Public sector workers protested against declining purchasing power amid rising fuel prices.

stories.title: Au Maroc, Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri devient la première femme nommée cheffe du gouvernement

en.title: In Morocco, Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri becomes the first woman appointed head of government
en.summary: Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri, a lawyer who previously served as mayor of Marrakech at age 33, has been appointed as Morocco's first female head of government. She must now form a governing coalition.

stories.title: Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri nommée cheffe du gouvernement marocain

en.title: Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri appointed head of Moroccan government
en.summary: Morocco's King Mohammed VI appointed Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri as head of government following her party's victory in recent legislative elections, marking the first time a woman has held this position in the country.

stories.title: Des bancs d’une fac française à la mairie de Marrakech… qui est Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri, la première femme nommée chef du gouvernement au Maroc

en.title: From French university benches to the mayoralty of Marrakech… who is Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri, the first woman appointed head of government in Morocco
en.summary: Following her party's legislative victory, former lawyer Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri was appointed by King Mohammed VI as Morocco's first female head of government.

stories.title: Blocus des lycées : 440 interpellations ce mardi, le ministre de l’Éducation nationale dénonce des «violences inqualifiables»

en.title: High school blockades: 440 arrests Tuesday, national education minister denounces 'inexcusable violence'
en.summary: Education minister Édouard Geffray reported 416 high schools were affected by disruptions on Tuesday, with dozens arrested and multiple injuries sustained among staff and students.

stories.title: Jordan Bardella accusé d’antisémitisme, une affaire qui fait grincer les rangs du RN

en.title: Jordan Bardella accused of antisemitism, an affair causing friction within National Rally ranks
en.summary: Following Mediapart's disclosure of alleged antisemitic remarks attributed to the National Rally leader, the party responded with various defensive statements while attacking the news outlet.

stories.title: Avocate, ancienne maire de Marrakech, première femme à la tête du Maroc… Fatima Ezzahra el-Mansouri, une Première ministre issue du sérail

en.title: Lawyer, former mayor of Marrakech, first woman leading Morocco… Fatima Ezzahra el-Mansouri, a Prime Minister from the establishment
en.summary: Former urban planning minister Fatima Ezzahra el-Mansouri must form a coalition government following legislative elections marked by the lowest voter turnout in two decades.

stories.title: Pouvoir d’achat : la fonction publique dans la rue pour « réclamer autre chose que des remerciements »

en.title: Purchasing power: civil service takes to streets to 'demand more than thanks'
en.summary: Public sector unions organized protests on September 29 against the government's announced wage freeze for 2027. Authorities reported 206,000 demonstrators nationwide, including 30,000 in Paris.

stories.title: Grève dans la fonction publique, blocus des lycées, une Première ministre au Maroc... L’actu de ce mardi 29 septembre

en.title: Public sector strike, high school blockades, a Prime Minister in Morocco... Tuesday, September 29 news roundup
en.summary: Libération's editorial team summarizes the main news events from Tuesday, September 29.

stories.title: 🔴 Maroc : Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri nommée cheffe du gouvernement, une première pour une femme

en.title: Morocco: Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri appointed head of government, a first for a woman
en.summary: Morocco's king appointed Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri as head of government, marking the first time a woman holds this position in the country.

stories.title: Au Maroc, le roi nomme pour la première fois une femme, Fatima Ezzahra El-Mansouri, à la tête du gouvernement

en.title: In Morocco, the king appoints a woman, Fatima Ezzahra El-Mansouri, to head the government for the first time
en.summary: Nearly a week after her party PAM's legislative victory, Marrakech's mayor was designated Prime Minister of Morocco on September 29, becoming the country's first female head of government.

stories.title: Correction des copies par IA : la start-up lyonnaise Ed.ai vise les universités américaines

en.title: AI essay correction: Lyon-based start-up Ed.ai targets American universities
en.summary: EdTech company Ed.AI raised 5 million euros to deploy its artificial intelligence-powered essay correction and exercise generation tool in secondary and higher education in France and the United States.

stories.title: Premier vol de l’A350F, l’arme de reconquête d’Airbus dans le très dynamique marché du fret

en.title: First flight of the A350F, Airbus's weapon to recapture the dynamic cargo market
en.summary: Airbus conducted the first flight of its A350F cargo aircraft, designed to compete in the lucrative freight market against older Boeing planes. The aircraft emphasizes energy efficiency and is expected to enter service by the end of 2027.

stories.title: Thierry Cozic (candidat PS à la présidence de la commission des finances du Sénat) : « Pour doter la France d’un budget, l’exécutif devra sortir de son couloir »

en.title: Thierry Cozic (PS candidate for Senate Finance Committee presidency): "To provide France with a budget, the executive will have to step out of its corridor"
en.summary: A re-elected Socialist senator is running to lead the Senate finance committee and outlined his priorities regarding taxation, green transition financing, and local government. He also detailed conditions for reaching a compromise on the 2027 budget.

stories.title: En Gironde, la saison touristique lourdement plombée par un été 2026 suffocant

en.title: In Gironde, the tourist season heavily hit by a suffocating summer 2026
en.summary: Wildfires and heat waves damaged tourism activity in Gironde and Landes regions, causing an immediate loss of 190 million euros in July and August. A September recovery partially offset the damage, though broader economic impacts remain significant.

en.title: Long-haul: Aegean changes dimension
en.summary: Greek airline Aegean will receive its first Airbus A321LR aircraft from October 2027 to establish long-haul routes to India, Africa, and Central Asia.
